response.title: Fixed Encoder Self-Attention Patterns in Transformer-Based Machine Translation
response.content_preview:
# Abstract

Transformer-based models have brought a radical change to neural machine translation. A key feature of the Transformer architecture is the so-called multi-head attention mechanism, which allows the model to focus simultaneously on different parts of the input.
